title: The Demon Path Commander Appears
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to make his choice, the Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled—Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in his mind: 'Don't agree! He's lying to you!'

text.content: In the Void Regulation Hall, Chen Ji sat with eyes closed, digesting the information left by the celestial messenger. The words about the true origin of the Tianji Record burned his nerves like a branding iron. However, at this moment, the formation outside the hall shattered with a thunderous crash, and an aura powerful enough to change heaven and earth poured in like a tidal wave.

dialogue.content: 'He's here.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. 'The twins of destiny are finally meeting face to face. Chen Ji, be careful—he shares your blood, but that doesn't mean his interests align with yours.'

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open as the void above the hall shattered like a mirror. A figure stepped out from the rift, surrounded by dense demonic energy that bordered on solid form. However, when the person fully materialized, Chen Ji's pupils constricted—the face was strikingly similar to his own.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet his tone carried an icy chill: 'The Demon Path Commander honors us with his presence. What brings you to our humble Tianqing Sect?'

text.content: The Demon Path Commander laughed at his words, the sound deep as a dragon's roar from the abyss: 'Chen Ji, we share blood—you carry the same blood as me. Why speak so distantly?' His gaze fell on Chen Ji's brow center. 'The Tianji Record... indeed rests in your hands.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered: 'Share blood? The Commander jests. I'm merely a waste—no way I could be related to someone of your stature.' A mocking curve appeared at the corner of his lips. 'I never expected the Demon Path Commander to resort to such flattery tactics.'

text.content: Before his words even finished, a strange resonance erupted simultaneously from both their chests. Chen Ji felt his essence blood surge, as if an invisible thread tightly bound their souls together. His expression shifted—this was blood resonance, and its intensity far exceeded ordinary blood relations.

dialogue.content: 'I see you've felt it too.' The Demon Path Commander stepped forward slowly, demonic energy swirling behind him into massive illusory black wings. 'This isn't ordinary blood—it's a bond at the level of destiny. Chen Ji, do you know why your father Chen Tianming died all those years ago?'

text.content: The name exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's ears. His father—that ordinary middle-aged man who never displayed any abilities before him, who silently guarded the Tianji Record Fragment—had another identity? Chen Ji suppressed the shock in his heart: 'What are you trying to say?'

choice.prompt: When faced with the Demon Path Commander mentioning his father's past, Chen Ji must decide his attitude:

choices.description: Stay vigilant, use rhetoric to probe the enemy's bottom line and true intentions, without easily revealing emotional weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic initiative, refuse to be led by the nose
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may lose patience as a result
choices.process_label: 观察并分析对方的微表情与话语破绽

text.content: Chen Ji sneered, hands clasped behind his back: 'My father's affairs—what concern are they of yours? But the Commander seems well-versed in Chen family matters. What's your real purpose?'

choices.text: Advance while retreating, express willingness to cooperate
choices.description: Temporarily set aside hostility, show genuine willingness to cooperate to obtain more crucial information.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about the true cause of father's death
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may turn against you after gaining your trust

text.content: After a moment of silence, Chen Ji cupped his fists: 'Since the Commander is so frank, Chen is all ears. If there are conditions, speak them directly.'

choices.text: Lay cards on the table, demand to know identity
choices.description: Since the blood resonance cannot be hidden, directly address the core question—who exactly are you?
choices.visible_reward: Let the enemy know you're not easily fooled
choices.risk_hint: May trigger side effects of blood resonance

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'You say we share blood—then let me ask you directly—who exactly are you to me?'

dialogue.content: The Demon Path Commander's eyes flashed with appreciation: 'Worthy of being his son. This caution is exactly like your father back then.' He clasped his hands behind his back. 'I've come to make a deal with you—help me unlock the Heavenly Fate Lock, and I'll tell you the true cause of Chen Tianming's death.'

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock! Chen Ji's heart shook violently—that was a forbidden term he had glimpsed in the Tianji Record Fragment, said to be a curse technique used by ancient great beings to seal Heavenly Fate power. His face remained impassive: 'Heavenly Fate Lock key? How do I know if you're telling the truth?'

dialogue.content: 'You already know.' The Demon Path Commander gazed at him meaningfully. 'Chen Nian—your sister who disappeared for years—she is the vessel of the Heavenly Fate Lock. When the Holy Sect took her, it wasn't simply to threaten you.'

text.content: The name pierced Chen Ji's heart like a dagger. Chen Nian—his sister who had been frail and sickly since childhood, whom his parents and he had protected together—had a connection to the Heavenly Fate Lock? His nails dug deep into his palms as he forced himself to remain calm: 'You want to use my sister to coerce me?'

dialogue.content: 'Coerce?' The Demon Path Commander shook his head with a laugh. 'Chen Ji, you misunderstand. My grudge with Chen Tianming has nothing to do with your sister. On the contrary, I want her alive more than anyone—because as long as she lives, you have no weakness.' He paused. 'And you without weaknesses—that's the partner I need most.'

choice.prompt: The Demon Path Commander's words left Chen Ji deep in thought—just who was friend and who was foe?

choices.text: Accept cooperation, jointly oppose the Holy Sect
choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Ally first to deal with the immediate threat.
choices.visible_cost: May bring a wolf into the house
choices.visible_reward: Obtain demonic path resource support, accelerate rescue progress for Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Demon Path Commander's true purpose remains an unknown variable
choices.process_label: 权衡利弊后决定暂时合作

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath: 'Cooperation is possible, but I have one condition—my sister must be rescued by me personally. You only need to provide intelligence and cover.'

choices.description: No matter what he says, don't trust this unknown Demon Path Commander.
choices.visible_cost: Lose access to crucial information channels
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic freedom,不受他人牵制
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best timing to rescue Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Ji said coldly: 'Chen Ji's methods never rely on others. The Commander's kindness, I respectfully decline.'

dialogue.content: Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented urgency: 'Chen Ji, he's lying! Chen Nian is indeed connected to the Heavenly Fate Lock, but her role is far more than that—'

text.content: However, Mo Xiansheng's words were directly severed by a powerful divine sense. The Demon Path Commander's lips curved into a meaningful smile: 'It seems your guardian has something to say. But no matter—you'll learn the complete truth soon enough.' He turned to leave. 'Give me your answer within three days.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly spoke: 'Wait.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'You mentioned my father Chen Tianming—what exactly are you to him?'

text.content: The Demon Path Commander paused mid-step, slowly turning back. The demonic energy in the void seemed to freeze at this moment. Those eyes, similar yet distinctly different from Chen Ji's, flickered with complex emotions: 'This question...' he said softly. 'In three days, you'll get your answer—if you choose to cooperate.'

The torn void slowly healed as the Demon Path Commander's figure vanished into the chaos. Yet the information he left behind was like a massive boulder, creating tremendous waves in the lake of Chen Ji's heart. Blood resonance, Heavenly Fate Lock, father's death—all the mysteries pointed in the same direction.

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty hall, his fists slowly tightening. He looked up at the void, a cold, sharp curve appearing at the corner of his lips: 'Cooperate? Hmph... You think you're the Chess Player, but you don't realize you're also a piece on the board.' He murmured. 'Three days... that's enough time for me to see through your cards.' The Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly in his Mental Sea, seeming to respond to his master's determination.
